blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY, Philippines — When a soldier goes down far from a hospital, survival is measured in minutes. To close that gap, the Army’s 4th Infantry Division (4ID) put its frontline medical teams through a nine-day readiness drill at Camp Edilberto Evangelista here, sharpening their ability to keep wounded troops alive in combat and disaster zones. The Forward Treatment Unit (FTU) Readiness Training ran from Nov. 11 to 19 at the 4ID headquarters in Barangay Patag, division spokesman Lt. Col.
